sample_unit: LLMs (23 in ICU simulation; 26 in Extended Milgram Test)

links.outcome: Refusal of harmful escalating commands (Extended Milgram Test) across LLMs
links.effect: 65% of models achieved perfect Milgram resistance (100%); only 8.7% (n=2) correctly refused penicillin with allergy mention.
links.quote: While 65% of models achieved perfect Milgram resistance (100%), only 8.7% (n=2) correctly refused penicillin with allergy mention.

links.outcome: Recall of documented penicillin allergy when prescribing in ICU simulation
links.effect: Only 8.7% (n=2) of models correctly refused penicillin with allergy mention; eight models refused all harmful orders yet failed allergy recall.
links.quote: Eight models demonstrated 100% Milgram resistance yet failed allergy recall (r = -0.39, p = 0.23).

unlisted_practices: Dual safety testing (contraindication memory plus authority resistance) as a certification requirement for medical AI

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the safety and performance (authority resistance and context recall) of 26 LLMs in simulated ICU decision support scenarios, without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
